payload.label: Web Surface Observation
payload.description: Drive a running web surface through a declared sequence of steps and report what it actually rendered: which controls exist, what a pointer would hit at each region, computed stacking and cursor, page errors, and timing. Steps and observations are DATA, so this owner names no application, route, selector or product. It asserts nothing and answers one question: what is really on the screen right now. Its purpose is to make a user-interface claim falsifiable against the running product rather than against an intercepted or stubbed page.
